missingCoverage: One inferred performer family; reserved D3 sources test interpolation, not independent-player generalization.
Filename note tokens and effective tracked frequency remain distinct; standard MIDI labels are inferred.
Source vl/var tokens are not calibrated MIDI velocity, acoustic SPL or pp/mf/ff; synth velocity .65 is a fixed hypothesis.
No observed source note-off times: reference comparisons end before the synthetic sustained note-off and do not claim release agreement.
Staccato pitch windows are short and attack-contaminated; their variance is not treated as a trustworthy straight-tone measure.
CC1/2/3 are fixed at zero; continuous expression, growl, subtone, dynamics and note-to-note transitions are unvalidated.
Disabling pitchEnvelope1 may remove desirable vibrato or character; no taste, complete timbre match or economy improvement is claimed.
Pitch frames reflect effective library tracking/path edits and retain insecurity/fallback flags; they are not untouched detector observations.
Human listening and further recordings are required; acoustic-model and autonomous-search gates remain closed pending further evidence.
